implemented_by_crystal_agent.support_tag: Adds base_stone_nether, common ore families, bedrock, and all six TC ore variants while keeping sturdy-face checks.
implemented_by_crystal_agent.biome_helper: CrystalBiomeAffinity.select(Holder<Biome>,RandomSource), nullable fallback; no aura/tree affinity changes.
implemented_by_crystal_agent.type_mapping: 29 original aspect-bearing types plus RARE/VOID null candidates. Alias tags count once per type; repeated aspects from distinct types retain weight. Taiga maps to both FOREST and CONIFEROUS.
